name: Belleville
seo_title: Belleville Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 3 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Belleville, Michigan for 2026: 3 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Belleville celebrates Christmas Downtown with a lighted parade on Main Street and a museum full of decorated trees and Santa.
celebrates: The Belleville Central Business Community presents Christmas Downtown Belleville, a season built around Main Street and the Belleville Area Museum. The Winterfest Light Parade steps off on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 5:30 pm, with trophies for the best entries. The same day the museum opens its Festival of Holiday Trees, where local groups decorate trees and wreaths and visitors vote for a favorite through December 22. On Saturdays, December 12 and 19, families can get free photos with Santa at the museum, with a special needs hour first. Donations are welcome and support museum programming.
lastyear: A Belleville Area Independent preview reported that in 2025 the annual Winterfest light parade stepped off at 5:30 pm on Saturday, December 6, from the Belleville High School parking lot. The museum's tree festival also ran last year: the township's page says 2026 is its third year, so the festival began in 2024. Santa photo days were part of the festival tradition, which the township says offers two Saturdays of free photos each season.
facts: The Festival of Holiday Trees has grown from a festive seasonal display into a showcase of creativity, generosity and community spirit, according to Van Buren Township. Trees come from businesses, organizations, families and individuals in Belleville, Van Buren Township and Sumpter Township. The Belleville Central Business Community lists Clement Insurance, Van Buren Township and WCCCD among its sponsors, and its event coordinator is Janet Millard. Its office is at 152 Main, Suite 2, in downtown Belleville.
trains: Belleville does not list a Christmas train ride of its own. For trains, The Henry Ford's Greenfield Village in Dearborn has a heritage railroad with an 1884 roundhouse, and the Michigan Transit Museum in Mount Clemens is a volunteer-run museum in an 1859 Grand Trunk depot. Check each page for current dates and rides, since schedules change, and look at our other Michigan guides for rides closer to you.

faq: When is the Belleville Winterfest Light Parade in 2026?
The Belleville Central Business Community posted Saturday, December 5, 2026, with the parade beginning at 5:30 pm on Main Street in downtown Belleville. The group says trophies are up for grabs.
When can kids see Santa in Belleville?
Photos with Santa are Saturday, December 12 and Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 11:30 am to 4 pm at the Belleville Area Museum. Photos for special needs, for all ages, run from 11:30 am to 12 pm.
What is the Festival of Holiday Trees?

It is a display of trees and wreaths decorated by local organizations, families and community partners at the Belleville Area Museum, open December 5 to 22, 2026, during regular hours. Visitors can vote for a favorite entry.
Do the Santa photos cost money?
No. The Belleville Central Business Community lists no charge, though donations are welcome. Van Buren Township says donations support museum programming.
The Belleville Central Business Community presents it, and Van Buren Township hosts the Belleville Area Museum page with the festival details.
